name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: The bar at the top of a site: its name, the main pages and one action.

props.name: brand
props.description: The site name at the start of the bar. It links home.

props.name: items
props.description: The main pages, each with a label and an href. Shown from 640 pixels wide.

props.name: active
props.description: The label of the current page.

props.name: action
